text: Yes, deforestation occurred on this asset in 2023. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) detected tree-cover loss of 0.7 hectares, which is 1.2% of the asset. This event was corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset, which confirmed the area was forested in 2020. The loss was primarily in planted forest (0.4 hectares of *Eucalyptus* species), with some outside mapped forest areas. While 0.4 hectares of loss occurred in small patches under 0.5 hectares (not counted as an event), the remaining 0.3 hectares met the minimum event size threshold. The evidence meets the corroboration rule, confirming deforestation in 2023.
